digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Thursday, October 1 has eight live meetings, one protected work block, six carried-over actions, and four urgent items. The day’s priorities are closing Incident Response ownership at 10:00 AM, getting a credible Amazon Connect recovery and rollout-readiness plan at 10:30 AM, and resolving the 3:00 PM Attorney Review conflict before the afternoon sequence. Amazon Connect remains the clearest delivery risk: Denver is still pending, Salesforce has no root-cause resolution, and incomplete user and skills data is blocking later rollout waves.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery and rollout-readiness plan
items.detail: Salesforce still has no root-cause resolution for the two open blockers, although a direct-dial workaround exists for one issue. Use the 10:30 AM standup to confirm the next diagnostic and owner, the Denver posture, the ETA for the user and skills audit, and one stakeholder reporting cadence; the incomplete roster is now blocking later rollout waves.
